name: wortomat
description: Wortomat – Software zum Schreiben von Büchern und Romanen

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @wortomat/backend" "npm run start -w @wortomat/frontend"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n frontend,desktop -c magenta,green "npm run start -w @wortomat/frontend" "npm run dev -w @wortomat/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wortomat/backend && npm run build -w @wortomat/frontend && npm run build -w @wortomat/desktop
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @wortomat/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @wortomat/desktop
